title: How Much Fiber in Chickpeas? 12.5g per Cup
description: Chickpeas: about 12.5 g of fiber per 1 cup, cooked (45% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in chickpeas?

answer.note: USDA FoodData Central, Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

intro: Chickpeas rank #6 of 10 beans and legumes on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in chickpeas by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in chickpeas?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt at 7.6 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 cup, cooked; 164 g) therefore has about 12.5 g of fiber and 269 calories. That is 45% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 50% of a 25 g day and 33% of a 38 g day.

Chickpeas (garbanzo beans) are the base of hummus, falafel, chana masala, and roasted snack chickpeas, so they show up in more forms than most legumes. Cooked chickpeas are a little lower in fiber per cup than black or navy beans, but still one of the strongest single foods you can add to a meal.

sections.heading: Whole chickpeas vs hummus vs roasted
paragraphs: Hummus is mostly chickpeas, but it also contains tahini, oil, and water, and the usual serving is only 2 tablespoons. That is why a scoop of hummus gives much less fiber than a scoop of whole chickpeas. See the [hummus](/fiber-in-hummus) page for dip-sized portions.

Roasting removes water, so a cup of crunchy roasted chickpeas weighs less and is more concentrated than a cup of cooked ones. For packaged roasted chickpeas, use the label: it reflects the brand’s recipe and serving weight.

sections.heading: How chickpeas compare with other beans and legumes
paragraphs: Of the 10 beans and legumes on this site, chickpeas rank #6 for fiber per typical serving and #8 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 4.6 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [kidney beans](/fiber-in-kidney-beans) at 11.3 g (1 cup, cooked); [black beans](/fiber-in-black-beans) at 15 g (1 cup, cooked); [pinto beans](/fiber-in-pinto-beans) at 15.4 g (1 cup, cooked). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), chickpeas are #26 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding chickpeas to your day
paragraphs: Toss half a cup into a grain bowl or green salad, or stir a drained can into a curry or soup that serves three or four people. A whole drained can is a lot of fiber for one sitting if you are not used to legumes.

Example: 1/2 cup chickpeas, 1 cup quinoa, 1 cup spinach. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 12.1 g of fiber, with 6.2 g from the chickpeas. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of chickpeas?
faqs.a: 7.6 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in chickpeas (1/2 cup, cooked)?
faqs.a: About 6.2 g, for 82 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.

faqs.q: Are canned chickpeas as high in fiber as cooked dried chickpeas?
faqs.a: Per gram they are in the same range. USDA lists drained canned chickpeas slightly lower per 100 g than home-boiled, which mostly reflects differences in water content. Drain and rinse, then log by weight or cup.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in a can of chickpeas?
faqs.a: A standard 15.5 oz can that drains to about 253 g has roughly the fiber shown in the table above. Check your can’s drained weight, since it varies by brand.
